definitions.explanation: Describes images, text, memories, or other things that lack clarity or sharpness. Used for both visual and abstract contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不鮮明|ふせんめい}だ。

⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ→防犯カメラ：07137_bouhankamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不鮮明|ふせんめい}で⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The security camera footage was too blurry to identify the perpetrator.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不鮮明|ふせんめい}で、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: The printing on the old document is unclear, and some characters are illegible.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal adjective formed with the negative prefix {不|ふ} and ⟦{鮮明|せんめい}→鮮明：14686_senmei⟧ (vivid, clear). Used primarily in written and technical contexts such as news, reports, and image analysis. In casual speech, ⟦ぼやけた→ぼやける：16967_boyakeru⟧ or ⟦ぼんやりした→ぼんやりする：21687_bonyarisuru⟧ are more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不鮮明|ふせんめい} (the footage is unclear)
- ⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不鮮明|ふせんめい} (the image is blurry)
- {不鮮明|ふせんめい}な⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (a blurry photo)
- {不鮮明|ふせんめい}な⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (a hazy memory)
